title: Mega-Sena Draw 3056 Jackpot Estimated at R$ 76 Million
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3056 Jackpot Estimated at R$ 76 Million
subtitle: Next Caixa draw rolls over with nearly R$ 69 million accumulated
excerpt: Mega-Sena draw 3056, scheduled for Thursday, features an estimated prize of R$ 76 million, following an R$ 68.87 million rollover from the previous contest.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Mega-Sena draw 3056 is scheduled to take place this Thursday, with an estimated prize of R$ 76 million. The projection comes after draw 3055 ended with no tickets matching all six numbers, rolling over nearly R$ 69 million.

Next draw and prize estimate

According to Caixa, the estimated amount for draw 3056 accounts for the R$ 68,876,401.91 rollover and expected ticket sales leading up to the draw. The R$ 76 million figure serves as the official projection.

Portion of proceeds reserved for draws ending in zero or five

In draws ending in zero or five, 22% of the proceeds allocated to prizes is accumulated for the six-number tier. This mechanism resulted in draw 3055, ending in five, yielding no winning tickets for the jackpot.

Prize tiers and five-number winners

In draw 3055, the quina (five numbers) was the highest tier with winners: 54 bets matched five of the six numbers, each receiving R$ 34,793.09. The other tiers (quadra and lower) are also awarded according to Mega-Sena rules.

Betting options offered by Caixa

The lottery allows players to choose numbers manually or use the Surpresinha, which generates a combination randomly. There is also the Teimosinha, which repeats the same bet across consecutive draws, and pools (bolões), which split the cost and prize among participants.

Deadline for claiming prizes

Mega-Sena prizes can be claimed within 90 calendar days from the draw date. After this period, the right to collect expires. For physical tickets, the original paper slip must be kept as proof, and Caixa recommends writing your full name and CPF on the back.

With information from Estadão.
